title: E2E: verify sound plays in published SWF via Ruffle
description: Sound import exists (UI + SoundPanel), but no Ruffle-based E2E test proves audio actually plays. This is hard to assert pixel-wise, so the acceptance bar is: (1) publish a SWF with an event sound on frame 1, (2) load in headless Ruffle, (3) assert no console errors, (4) assert the SWF has StartSound tags (can check via swf-dump or unit test). Stretch: use Playwright Web Audio API stubs to assert AudioContext.decodeAudioData is called. Cross-ref packages/swf/src/__tests__/sound.test.ts to understand what's already tested.
